company.name: AOMOTU
company.shortDescription: A multi-service agency that bridges the gap between digital creativity and physical brand execution.

welcome.author: Jamaica B. Escolano
quote: The ones you hire, the ones you trust, and the ones who share your vision, determine whether you succeed or fail.
Your business doesn't rise because of your idea, it will rise because of your people.
It's not the product, the timing, or the market, it's the people.

background: AOMOTU is a dynamic agency where digital imagination meets real world outcomes. We at AOMOTU are dedicated to innovation, sustainability and empowerment. We advocate ethical standards, wellness-oriented solutions and collaborative approaches to help companies thrive in competitive marketplaces. We develop ideas into powerful brands that engage with people and generate measurable results through online campaigns, printed materials, gifts and product distribution.

Our backbone structure consists of robust manufacturing, offset printing, technology and trade activities. Through this integrated approach, we are able to create end-to-end solutions that carry businesses from concept to customer seamlessly.

AOMOTU is a multi-service agency that bridges the gap between digital creativity and physical brand execution. It offers end-to-end solutions combining digital advertising, marketing strategy, outsourcing operations, manufacturing, offset printing, corporate giveaways, and trading — all under one unified ecosystem.

purpose.intro: By integrating technology, design, and production, AOMOTU enables businesses to scale efficiently, build stronger brand identities, and deliver consistent experiences across both online and offline channels.
points: We provide comprehensive advertising, marketing, and outsourcing services that combine digital innovation with product development to support brand growth.

Support product development and distribution by leveraging the manufacturing arm, which produces skincare, cosmetics, fragrances, household essentials, cleaning products, and sanitation solutions, beverages, supplements, and color cosmetics.
Enhance brand visibility through offset printing (Labels and Packaging) and corporate giveaways to reinforce identity and engage customers.
Support market expansion by serving as a trading company for brands from the manufacturing division, enabling smooth entry into various markets.
Promote sustainability and wellness by ensuring product innovation aligns with ethical practices and supports consumer well-being.

vision: We aspire to ignite a global movement as the premier hub for integrated advertising, marketing, and outsourcing services. At AOMOTU, we spark transformation, turning ideas into iconic brands and delivering sustainable results that elevate solutions that drive business growth. Our passion fuels innovation and wellness keeps us at the forefront of global markets.

mission.intro: At AOMOTU, our mission is to:
points: Elevate brands by combining digital advertising expertise with manufacturing and trading capabilities.
Deliver holistic solutions that integrate offset printing, corporate giveaways, and omnichannel marketing strategies.

Support product innovation and distribution across skincare, cosmetics, color cosmetics, fragrance and perfumery, household products, cleaning and janitorial solutions, and alcohol and sanitation essentials.
Strengthen identity and visibility through creative campaigns and tangible brand assets.
Champion sustainability and wellness by aligning ethical practices with consumer needs.
Drive measurable growth by acting as a transformational partner for businesses seeking scalability, efficiency, and long-term success.

paragraphs: AOMOTU Inc. is originally founded by the Mastermind “Jamaica Base Escolano” — “Jam” — on a principle of distributed intelligence. She conceptualized a one stop shop to build bespoke marketing pipelines and localized media hubs. Guided by her vision, “Jam” started off collaborating ideas and concepts with her sister to maximize a global concept and materialize digital concept. Year 2023 she officially dropped an ecosystem of a powerhouse which has a complete setup of branding; as formulator, artist and geologist by profession, she materialized the tradition and her sister the digi-works that meets the outsourcing, digital solutions into innovation.

AOMOTU, as “Jam” integrates a unique operational model which has borderless digital solutions, continues building the empire. She builds with the people she incorporates her mission, vision, goals and values.
story.closing: Now, we span 16 countries as a limitless and borderless one-stop shop ecosystem globally.

uvp.statement: AOMOTU is the only partner that connects digital marketing with manufacturing, printing and commerce to provide holistic growth from concept to consumer. AOMOTU stands out through its integrated business model — combining creative digital expertise with tangible production capabilities.
uvp.usp: AOMOTU is the combination of digital innovation and real brand solutions to help businesses flourish. It empowers businesses to grow by uniting digital innovation with tangible brand solutions. We don't simply sell your concept or market your vision. We make it. We print it. We package it. We exchange it into reality.

items.label: Sonic Branding
items.body: Creating a musical logo or short audio mnemonic that makes the brand instantly recognizable.

items.label: Studio Time
items.body: Access to a soundproof recording environment equipped with professional microphones, pre-amps, and monitoring gear.

items.label: Engineering
items.body: On-site audio technician to manage gain staging, microphone placement, and track organization.

items.label: Session Management
items.body: Directing the talent, managing take logs, and ensuring all raw audio files are captured at professional standards (24-bit/48kHz).

items.label: Casting
items.body: Sourcing and auditioning professional voice talent — accents, tone, age ranges — to fit the project.

items.label: Direction
items.body: Coaching the talent on pacing, emphasis, and emotional delivery to ensure the script resonates with the target audience.

items.label: File Clean-up
items.body: Removing breath noise, clicks, and background hums from the raw vocal tracks.

items.label: Level Balancing
items.body: Adjusting the volume of individual elements — vocals, instruments, SFX — so they sit perfectly in the final track.

items.label: Frequency Management (EQ & Compression)
items.body: Using industry-standard processing to ensure clarity, warmth, and professional impact.

items.label: Spatial Effects
items.body: Adding reverb, delay, and stereo widening to create depth and professional polish.

items.label: Mastering
items.body: Final limiting and volume normalization to ensure the audio meets loudness standards for TV, radio, or streaming (Spotify/YouTube).

items.label: Custom Scoring
items.body: Composing background music for videos, ads, or presentations that avoids copyright issues (royalty-free or exclusive rights).

items.label: Instrumentation
items.body: Sourcing or recording live instruments or high-quality virtual instrument libraries.

items.label: Sync Rights
items.body: Clearing and assigning full usage rights for the client to use the music across various media platforms.

items.label: Booking
items.body: Negotiating rates, contracts, and schedules for singers, voice actors, or session musicians.

items.label: Logistics
items.body: Managing studio arrival times, refreshment needs, and technical riders.

items.label: Rights & Releases
items.body: Managing legal paperwork, talent releases, and usage agreements to ensure the client holds the rights to the performance.

services.title: PR & Communications
services.blurb: Retained counsel, media relations, press events and crisis response — reputation handled properly.

items.label: Strategic Counsel
items.body: Monthly meetings to align PR efforts with business goals and market trends.

items.label: Monitoring & Reporting
items.body: Tracking media sentiment, brand mentions, and providing a monthly analysis report of reach and impact.

items.label: Reputation Management
items.body: Proactive monitoring of online discussions to maintain a positive brand image.

items.label: Media List Maintenance
items.body: Constantly updating and cultivating the database of journalists, influencers, and industry contacts.

items.label: Pitching
items.body: Proactively reaching out to editors, journalists, and producers to secure media placements.

items.label: Relationship Management
items.body: Hosting informal meetups, building rapport, and positioning the client as an industry expert to media gatekeepers.

items.label: Interview Preparation
items.body: Preparing briefing documents, talking points, and Q&A prep for clients before media appearances.

items.label: Desk-side Briefings
items.body: Coordinating one-on-one meetings between clients and key target media outlets.

items.label: Drafting & Content
items.body: Writing news-worthy, AP-style press releases that capture interest and adhere to industry standards.

items.label: Distribution
items.body: Pushing content to wire services (such as PR Newswire and local business journals) and targeted distribution lists.

items.label: Multimedia Integration
items.body: Enhancing releases with high-quality images, infographics, or video links to increase pick-up rates.

items.label: Follow-up
items.body: Calling and emailing journalists post-distribution to track status and pitch angles for follow-up stories.

items.label: Media Invitations & RSVP
items.body: Creating target media lists, managing secure invitations, and handling RSVP tracking.

items.label: On-site Press Management
items.body: Running a dedicated press desk or media area, handing out press kits, and managing photo and video opportunities.

items.label: Production
items.body: Coordinating the event logistics — AV, lighting, venue — specifically to optimize for media coverage.

items.label: Post-Event Follow-up
items.body: Distributing event photos, transcripts, and thank-you notes to all attendees to encourage coverage.

items.label: Campaign Strategy
items.body: Defining the hook, identifying the target audience, and selecting the right media mix (traditional versus digital).

items.label: Asset Creation
items.body: Developing specialized campaign themes, landing pages, and creative PR collateral.

items.label: Launch Timeline
items.body: Managing a multi-channel rollout — teasers, embargoed releases, launch day, and follow-up stories.

items.label: Outcome Evaluation
items.body: Measuring success against pre-defined KPIs such as number of placements, audience reach, and estimated ad value.

items.label: Vulnerability Assessment
items.body: Identifying potential risks to the brand's reputation before they become emergencies.

items.label: Crisis Playbook
items.body: Developing standardized holding statements, internal FAQs, and communication protocols for various scenarios.

items.label: Active Response
items.body: Serving as the direct spokesperson or advising leadership in real-time during a public incident.

items.label: Post-Crisis Recovery
items.body: Implementing a long-term strategy to rebuild trust and neutralize negative press coverage.

services.title: Talent, KOL & Influencer
services.blurb: Sourcing, vetting, booking and managing the faces of your campaign — from micro-creators to celebrities.

items.label: Database Access
items.body: Utilizing professional networks to identify talent that fits specific demographic and aesthetic requirements.

items.label: Vetting
items.body: Background checks, social sentiment analysis, and verifying engagement authenticity by checking for fake followers and bots.

items.label: Availability Screening
items.body: Handling the initial outreach to check schedules and interest levels before presenting a shortlist to the client.

items.label: Representation Liaison
items.body: Direct negotiation with agents, managers, and publicists to secure celebrities for appearances or endorsements.

items.label: Contract Management
items.body: Handling complex legal riders, payment schedules, and usage rights — where, when, and how long the celebrity's image can be used.

items.label: Logistics & Rider Fulfillment
items.body: Managing celebrity rider requirements: travel, accommodation, catering, security, and hair and makeup.

items.label: Strategy & Briefing
items.body: Defining the campaign goal — awareness versus conversion — and developing detailed creative briefs for the influencers.

items.label: Campaign Rollout
items.body: Overseeing the content production timeline, from initial draft submission to final posting.

items.label: Tracking & Optimization
items.body: Real-time monitoring of campaign performance (clicks, engagement) and adjusting strategy mid-campaign if needed.

items.label: Long-term Relationship Building
items.body: Nurturing relationships with industry experts and niche authorities for ongoing brand ambassadorships.

items.label: Performance Auditing
items.body: Providing deep-dive analytics on how well the KOL's audience responds to specific messages or product claims.

items.label: Community Integration
items.body: Coordinating KOL appearances at industry events, webinars, or as featured experts in company content.

items.label: Audition Management
items.body: Organizing and managing casting calls, in-person or digital, for actors, models, or spokespeople.

items.label: Shortlisting
items.body: Providing high-quality video and photo reels and headshots to the client for final selection.

items.label: Contractual Execution
items.body: Finalizing the service agreements and performance releases for the selected cast members.
